comparator.academicYear: Adopted 2026–2027 ordinary cohort requirements; checked against the completed 7 October audit and current source retrieval on 8 October 2026
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official programme page corroborates the broad Dutch 180-EC bachelor, five prescribed semesters and a minor semester, with 24 required modules in five learning lines. The adopted 2026–2027 regulation and semester schedule, verified in the completed 7 October audit, specify 150 required EC: six design modules ON1–ON4/IOP1–IOP2 at 10 EC (60); six science/skills modules WV1–WV6 at 5 (30); five technology modules TE1–TE5 at 5 (25); four foundations modules GR1–GR4 at 5 (20); three society modules MA1–MA3 at 5 (15). The genuine 30-EC minor completes 180. The existing three year-total placeholders are replaced by the individual coded modules and minor, each counted once in the formal semester/year placement. The final Bachelor Eindproject comprises IOP1, IOP2, TE5 and WV6, totaling 30 within these existing credits; no additional thesis or project credit is appended. Code/learning-line labels are descriptive, not invented catalogue titles. The programme page freshly retrieved on 8 October corroborates the module counts/weights, design/technology/social synthesis and written reflection. Fresh regulation download returned HTTP 502, so its table authority and visual inspection are explicitly carried from the 7 October audit rather than represented as a new retrieval.
